dw-dossier.name: Dossier
dw-dossier.changelog:
2.5.0 (includes 2.4.11, 2.4.12 and 2.4.13, which were not published)

New: DeadWatch fleet access. An agency can run Dossier's tools on each paired site from its DeadWatch account, one site at a time. A site administrator decides what the site accepts, in wp-admin (Dossier, Settings, Advanced, MCP Server): off, reads and checks, or reads and changes. It is off until somebody sets it, so an update alone changes nothing. Only a signed request from the paired DeadWatch account gets in. Such a call reads what a visitor could read. Drafts, private and password-protected pages stay on the site. A change also needs the Dossier change right in DeadWatch and "Allow write tools" not stored off. The choice belongs to one pairing. Turning off another SEO plugin and the export never run from DeadWatch. Nothing that comes through DeadWatch installs, updates, turns on or turns off a plugin.

New: Autopilot. A site administrator can switch it on in wp-admin so a connected agent runs first setup, and the move from another SEO plugin, without asking before each batch. They tick what it may do and pick 2, 8, 24 or 72 hours. No tool starts it and words in a chat do not start it. Off on every site until an administrator switches it on. A noindex, nofollow or canonical change, new redirects, deletions, tracking code, robots.txt text, keys and plugin installs wait for a person under any grant. With fleet access on "reads and changes", a person signed in to the paired DeadWatch account can start a grant for the site from there. A token cannot. Such a grant never covers turning off the other SEO plugin.

New tool switch-off-seo-plugin: turns off the one other SEO plugin Dossier detects, only under a wp-admin grant that ticked that box and the backup box, and only when its thirteen checks pass. Nothing is deleted. The same tool turns the plugin back on for 24 hours.

New: Squirrly SEO is a copy source for migrate-to-dossier. Only an empty Dossier field is filled and nothing of Squirrly's is changed. The preview lists every page a copy would mark noindex or nofollow.

New tool update-services: a description and a page address for services already in the business profile.

New setting One sitemap: switches off wp-sitemap.xml and redirects it to /sitemap.xml. Off until somebody turns it on.

Fix: schema stored through Dossier on a Squirrly site was never printed. Dossier keeps the document in its own field and prints it. Older documents are moved once after the update.
Fix: a schema store with an @graph printed nothing and the page lost its JSON-LD.
Fix: a schema store removed the curly braces from address templates such as ?s={search_term_string}.
Fix: /sitemap.xml could answer 404 after an update until the permalinks were saved.
Fix: a post whose author account was deleted printed an Article with an empty author.

A schema Dossier would not print is refused before it is stored, with the reason, and the page keeps the schema it had.
A one-line business address is printed in parts where it can be read safely. presence.w4 carries local.address_parts.
A write to one page asks a known page cache to clear that page only, at most 25 addresses per request, never a whole site.
After Squirrly is switched off, Dossier reads the titles, descriptions and canonicals stored through Dossier while Squirrly ran.

After the update: on a site that moved from Squirrly to Dossier's own output, a page marked noindex or nofollow through Dossier while Squirrly ran starts printing that. Check the Index column in the page list.

Not changed: a session on the site and the MCP key work as before. No tool turns on "Allow write tools". Full notes are in CHANGELOG.md.
